reviews.title: Loader recovery and the raw SWF execution boundary
reviews.summary: Images and NeoFlash child bundles retain useful loading, cancellation and callback recovery. Raw SWF loading exposes a diagnosed header container without executing the movie display list, timeline or bytecode, so load and loadBytes are Partial. Other declarations retain their existing classification.

entries.note: Supported images and NeoFlash child bundles load with cancellation and callback recovery. Raw SWF yields a diagnosed header container without movie display, timeline or bytecode execution; application and security-domain behavior remains bounded.
